exposure: acute kidney injury (AKI) during intrapartum or immediate postpartum period
cohort: 71 pregnant women with pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (pr-AKI) and 142 matched controls
finding: Women who are overweight, have prolonged rupture of the membranes, an emergency Cesarean section and/or postpartum hemorrhage are at greatest risk of pr-AKI.
mod_finding: Delivery by emergency Cesarean section was strongly associated with pr-AKI (p < 0.001).
